verdict.rationale: Google Calendar does offer appointment booking pages, so this booking-link time-zone story applies. However, the evidence pack has nothing on detecting an invitee's time zone, showing slots in local time, or handling daylight saving time automatically. The only time-zone mention is an unrelated smart-fridge sign-in troubleshooting tip.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, invitees always see slots in their own time zone — detection, display, and DST handling are automatic
